data.notes: June 2026 is already stacked with major Ibiza residencies and opening dates across Hï Ibiza, Ushuaïa Ibiza, Pacha, DC10 and [UNVRS].

events.title: Carl Cox Opening Party
events.summary: Carl Cox opens his Sunday [UNVRS] residency with an all-night-long Main Room set and melon bomb listed on the Wild Comet stage. The official page confirms Sundays from 21 June to 4 October 2026.

events.title: Calvin Harris at Ushuaïa Ibiza
events.summary: Calvin Harris headlines Ushuaïa Ibiza on Friday 26 June with MK and Tyson O’Brien listed. Ushuaïa confirms Harris’ Friday residency runs from 29 May to 2 October 2026, with additional Tuesday dates beginning in July.

events.title: Swedish House Mafia Opening Date
events.summary: Swedish House Mafia begin their 2026 Sunday residency at Ushuaïa Ibiza on 28 June, with the page listing Swedish House Mafia + TBA. The official source confirms the residency runs every Sunday from 28 June to 13 September 2026.

events.title: Solomun+1 with Chloé Caillet
events.summary: Solomun brings his long-running Solomun+1 concept to Pacha Ibiza, with Chloé Caillet listed as the guest for 14 June. The Pacha page confirms the 2026 Sunday residency runs from 31 May to 4 October.

events.title: J Balvin & DJ Snake
events.summary: J Balvin and DJ Snake debut a new collaborative show concept at Ushuaïa Ibiza on 14 June, with a second listed date on 21 June. The official page frames it as a world-premiere meeting of reggaeton, Latin anthems, trap and techno.

events.title: Marco Carola Presents Music On
events.summary: Marco Carola’s Music On takes over Pacha Ibiza on 26 June with Luciano, Franky Rizardo, Ilario Alicante, Fleur Shore and Prunk listed. Pacha presents Music On as one of Ibiza’s most influential Friday-night tech-house residencies.

events.title: Black Coffee at Hï Ibiza
events.summary: Black Coffee headlines Hï Ibiza’s Saturday Theatre, with Darque also listed and Skepta’s Más Tiempo in the Club Room. The official page confirms the Saturday residency runs from 2 May to 3 October 2026.

events.title: Solid Grooves Opening 2026
events.summary: Solid Grooves begins its 2026 Thursday season at DC10 Ibiza on 4 June. DC10 describes the party as a key underground house and techno residency on the island.

events.title: Dom Dolla Opening Party
events.summary: Dom Dolla opens his Friday Hï Ibiza residency, with Ewan McVicar, Luuk Van Dijk and Dam Swindle listed in the Club Room. The official page confirms every Friday from 5 June to 28 August 2026.

events.title: John Summit Presents Experts Only Opening Party
events.summary: John Summit opens his Experts Only Monday residency at [UNVRS] with Max Styler, AYYBO and Cole Knight. The source lists the residency as running every Monday from 1 June to 27 July 2026.

events.title: MESTIZA with Indira Paganotto Presents ARTCORE
events.summary: MESTIZA headline the Hï Ibiza Theatre on 21 June with Floyd Lavine B2B Pomboklap and Padu & Belu; Indira Paganotto’s ARTCORE takes the Club Room with Héctor Oaks, Negitiv and Luna Passos. The official page confirms MESTIZA Sundays from 31 May to 28 June and again from 6 September to 4 October 2026.

events.title: One Special Sunset with Armin van Buuren
events.summary: Armin van Buuren returns to Ushuaïa Ibiza for a one-off headline sunset show on Thursday 18 June 2026. Ushuaïa describes it as his only outdoor island performance of the year.

events.title: Circoloco Ibiza - June Mondays at DC10
events.summary: Circoloco's Monday DC10 run continues through June, with Week 7 listing Alinka, ANOTR, Arapu, Bambounou, Damian Lazarus, Luciano, Omar+, Priku, Prospa, Rony Seikaly and Sossa.

events.title: Black Coffee Saturdays at Hï Ibiza
events.summary: Black Coffee's flagship Saturday residency continues through June, with Afro-house in the Theatre and Skepta's Más Tiempo house concept in the Club Room.

events.title: Solid Grooves Opening Party
events.summary: Michael Bibi and PAWSA's tech-house institution opens its DC10 season with ANOTR, Beltran, Ben Sterling, Carlita, Dennis Cruz, Blackchild, Salomé Le Chat, Toman and more.

events.title: Pyramid at Amnesia Ibiza
events.summary: Amnesia's music-first underground brand begins its Sunday season in June, with the 21 June edition featuring a TRIP takeover led by Nina Kraviz alongside Vladimir Dubyshkin, u.r.trax and cerrot.

events.title: Major League DJz presents Echoes of Tomorrow
events.summary: Major League DJz bring a full Friday residency to Chinois, positioning Amapiano, Afro-house and African electronic music at the centre of an Ibiza Marina dancefloor.

events.title: MESTIZA at Hï Ibiza
events.summary: MESTIZA's Sunday residency brings flamenco-rooted, Latin-groove and Afro-house-influenced electronic music to the Hï Theatre, with ArtCore techno programming in the Club Room.

events.title: East End Dubs presents Eastenderz - Opening Party
events.summary: East End Dubs launches Eastenderz' debut Ibiza residency, pairing deep tech/minimal house with Paco Osuna's NOW HERE Club Room programme across Tuesdays in June.

events.title: Defected at Chinois Ibiza
events.summary: The UK house institution takes over Chinois Thursdays in June, with listed dates including Jonas Blue, Low Steppa and Malive on 4 June; Armand Van Helden, Darius Syrossian and Melé on 11 June; and DJ EZ/Hannah Wants on 25 June.
